description.en: The restore drill (W-PITR, R-BEBOPDB D.1 #10). Input: one nightly copy as the venue's bucket holds it (`cloud::push_place`: <prefix>/<venue>/<stamp>.json[.gz][.sealed], format dowiz-hub-backup/1) after seal-open and gunzip, and the census uploaded beside it (<stamp>.witness.json). Every image is base64-decoded strictly, checked against its manifest sha256 and length, and loaded through the loader the venue object uses (Hub::load, Catalog::load = Kv::load_checked with crc, Settings/Posts/StockLog/LogImage::load); a quarantined record is a refusal. The order log's chain is walked (chain_check) and its tip compared with the witness's: EQUAL, HELD (in the log or an archive of the copy) or MISSING (refused). The menu journal is replayed against the copy's catalogue. Writes nothing. The restore direction is hubstore::import (POST /api/owner/restore), into a venue with no images only.

producer.what: push_place: the bundle and the witness the bucket receives

the drill over a copy the real nightly path produced, in process
